description: This file defines a Flutter widget `TodoListTile` that visually represents a Todo item with toggle, edit, and delete actions. It utilizes provided callbacks for interactions and displays the Todo's title, description, and completion status.

classes.name: TodoListTile
classes.description: A stylized list tile representing a Todo item with complete toggle, edit, and delete actions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI based on the provided `Todo` object and callback functions.
